My master's thesis studied bio-inspired collective robotics with a focus on multi-robot foraging and division of labour. The project connected agent-based models of collective behaviour with robotic systems, asking how local decision rules can produce useful group-level outcomes.

Supervisors: Simon Garnier and P. B. Sujit.
